designDecision.whatSPIs: Determined live from Elgin's own published GIS material, not guessed: the Elgin_Zoning FeatureServer/0 (Bastrop side) layer's own service-level description field (authored by 'The City of Elgin' per its copyrightText) reads verbatim: 'Zoning Codes and Descriptions: R-1 Single Family, R-2 Single Family & Duplex, R-3 Single Family, Duplex & Mobile Home, A Multiple Family, C-1 Neighborhood Shopping District, C-2 General Commercial District, C-3 Highway Commercial District, I General Industrial District, S-P Special Permit'. Independently, each of the 11 live S-P features' own 'Zoning' attribute field reads 'Specific Use' (queried live via the FeatureServer's REST query endpoint, not inferred). A general web search's own synthesized answer claimed S-P meant 'Neighborhood Shopping District' -- that claim was NOT trusted or used; it was checked against and contradicted by the primary source (C-1 is actually Neighborhood Shopping District; the search summary appears to have conflated codes) and discarded per DEV_PROCESS 3.2a (a correction/claim needs a quoted source, not a paraphrase).
designDecision.noHonestEquivalent: property-reasoning/district-code-section-map.ts's own ELGIN_TX_MAP (pre-existing, unrelated code, written by an earlier lane) documents that Elgin's Chapter 46 Sec. 46-203 establishes exactly 8 base districts: R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4 (mapped from GIS code 'A'), C-1, C-2, C-3, I -- each with its own 'Area regulations' and 'Uses permitted' ordinance sections. S-P/Specific-Use/Special-Permit is categorically different: per Elgin's Planning & Development process (independently corroborated: the city's SUP application process, e.g. 'SUP 700 Bull Run'), a Specific Use Permit grants case-by-case conditions set in an individual ordinance for that one parcel, not a shared district's fixed dimensional/use table. Forcing S-P into any of the 8 (e.g. into a plausible-looking C-1 or R-3 neighbour) would assert that parcel carries that district's actual use/dimensional standards, which is not true of a specific-use grant. Decision: no forced mapping; stage S-P under its own identity ('S-P': 'S-P'), matching this program's existing identity-mapping convention for R-1..I.
